comparison.objective: Sequence and close four carton flaps ready for taping versus commission an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered manipulation of articulated/deformable flaps with interference management versus rigid fine-tool use, collar adjustment, locking, and physical response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: All four flaps must end correctly closed for taping; candidate requires two quantitatively compliant rigid-body stops without unsafe shortcuts or damage.
comparison.reason: Carton closure tests flap sequencing and deformation, not shock-absorber calibration. The record contains no fuller closure rubric.
